_about: Guest-facing copy for the hotel pages, keyed by the page slug. The facts come from data/hotels.json (the spreadsheet); this file is the words. No em dashes, no supplier names, guide prices only, nothing internal. photos: [{file, small, alt}] per hotel, files under public/getaways/img/hotels/; the list order is the display order (the first is the hero, the rest make the swipe strip and the viewer), the file numbers are just names. roomPhotos: {room name exactly as the sheet has it: file} puts that photo on the room card; a photo that is also in the photos list opens the viewer.

riu-plaza.intro: The one most of our Panama guests pick. A 644 room tower on Calle 50 in Marbella, right in the middle of the business and shopping streets, with an outdoor pool, a gym and a lobby sushi lounge that stays open late. Rooms were refreshed in 2025.
goodToKnow: Bed and breakfast, not all-inclusive: the buffet runs 6:30 to 10:30 with live cooking stations and gluten-free options, and the city is on your doorstep for everything else.
Room service runs 24 hours and valet parking is available, both at a charge.
Marbella is walkable to Calle 50's restaurants and a short taxi to the Cinta Costera and Multiplaza.

megapolis.intro: A 62 storey tower on Avenida Balboa, the seafront boulevard, so the views from the upper floors are the reason people book it. There is a pool with the Float Bar and sunbeds, a Mediterranean and Panamanian restaurant, two bars and a nightclub in the building.
goodToKnow: On Avenida Balboa by Panama Bay, a short taxi to the Cinta Costera waterfront and Casco Viejo.
Kosher rooms are available, and there is a family suite that sleeps six.
Not pet friendly.

las-americas.intro: A five star tower in Marbella, a block off Avenida Balboa, with 285 rooms that start at a generous 44 square metres. Aurum on the fifth floor does the fine dining, Union Market is the food hall, and the sixth floor holds the spa and a gym that never closes.
goodToKnow: Buffet breakfast is included on the standard rate.
The pool is indoor and climate controlled, so it works whatever the weather is doing.
Two accessible room categories are sold in their own right, both 44 square metres.

marinn-place.intro: A five star hotel in Bella Vista, the Financial District, with a rooftop pool that looks across the skyline. Every room is 34 square metres with a sofa bed and a divided living and sleeping space, which is why families and friends sharing like it.
goodToKnow: Three room categories, all the same size, all with a sofa bed; the Deluxe Double sleeps four.
Breakfast is served in the Dann Carlton restaurant, from breakfast through to brunch.
Walking distance to the Financial District's restaurants, a short taxi to Avenida Balboa and the Cinta Costera.

ramada-plaza.intro: A 135 room hotel in Punta Pacifica, the newer district beside Multiplaza Pacific Mall, with an outdoor pool, a panoramic gym, a spa with a sauna and hot tub, and a free buffet breakfast that starts at 6:30, which suits an early flight home.
goodToKnow: Children 12 and under stay free.
Check-in 3:00 pm, check-out 12:00 noon.
Multiplaza Pacific Mall and the ATLAPA Convention Centre are close by; the Cinta Costera is a short taxi.
No pets, though service animals are welcome.

hospedium-princess.intro: Our best value in the city. A 124 room hotel at the World Trade Centre in Marbella with an outdoor pool, a gym, a sauna and spa, a volleyball court and a buffet restaurant doing Andean and international dishes. Rooms run from a compact 20 square metres up to 52.
goodToKnow: Rates come room only or with breakfast; tell us which you want when you ask for a quote.
About 15 minutes from the airport, and Panama Viejo is around 10 minutes away.
Long stays of 7 and 30 nights have their own rates.

dreams-playa-bonita.intro: The beach resort that pairs with Panama City without a long drive. Dreams Playa Bonita sits twenty minutes from the centre and forty from the airport, with 301 rooms in eleven seaside towers, every one with an ocean view and a private balcony, two kilometres of beach in the Punta Bruja nature reserve and four pools, two of them adults only.
goodToKnow: Unlimited Luxury means taxes and gratuities are in, there are no wristbands, and dinner at the four a la carte restaurants never needs a reservation.
Rooms with two double beds take four people but no more than three adults; every suite sleeps two.
Explorer's Club keeps children aged 3 to 12 busy from 9:00 am to 9:00 pm.
Spa treatments, golf, tours and airport transfers are charged extra.

decameron-panama.intro: The big one. Grand Decameron Panama is an 852 room all-inclusive at Farallon on the Pacific coast, about ninety minutes from Panama City, with six pools in one beachfront complex, a three flume water slide park, an outdoor cinema, nightly shows, seven a la carte restaurants and two buffets. Families and groups love it.
goodToKnow: All Inclusive Plus adds a private restaurant for breakfast and lunch, an exclusive pool and lounge bar, premium drinks, unlimited Wi-Fi and a separate check-in. Say if you want it quoted.
King rooms sleep three, two double bed rooms sleep four adults.
Bars run from 9:00 am to 2:00 am, with a hydration station covering the small hours.
Golf next door at Mantarraya, spa treatments and motorised water sports cost extra.

riu-playa-blanca.intro: A five star all-inclusive on Playa Blanca in Cocle with 573 rooms, four pools including an adults only pool with a swim-up bar, a children's pool with slides, and three kilometres of Pacific beach. All-inclusive runs 24 hours, with four restaurants and five bars.
goodToKnow: Standard rooms are 35 square metres, and there is a triple room category for three sharing.
RIU Land kids club and the slides pool make it an easy pick with children.
Free Wi-Fi throughout, a 24 hour gym, and free open-air parking.
No pets.

suites-del-bosque.intro: The hotel from our two-country trip. Suites del Bosque is a 55 suite boutique hotel in San Isidro, the leafy financial and residential heart of Lima, a short walk from the El Olivar olive grove. Every room is a suite, most of them loft style with a sitting area and a sofa bed, so couples get space and families skip the second room.
goodToKnow: Quiet and residential, not a resort: there is no pool.
Two kitchenette categories suit a week or more.
Free parking, free Wi-Fi, a gym on the third floor, and dogs are welcome (ask us about size limits and fees).
About 30 minutes from the airport, traffic depending.

nobility.intro: A 58 room four star hotel in Miraflores with its own Mediterranean restaurant, a cafe bar, a gym, a sauna and a jacuzzi. Small enough to be looked after, and the price sits with Suites del Bosque.
goodToKnow: Breakfast is a daily hot and cold buffet from 6:30 to 10:30, with a Creole breakfast on Sundays.
Free parking on site, free Wi-Fi, 24 hour room service, and an airport shuttle on request at a charge.
Check-in 2:00 pm, check-out 12:00 noon.
About 20 to 30 minutes from the airport, traffic depending.

nhow.intro: The design hotel. nhow Lima is a 243 room tower in the middle of Miraflores built around contemporary Peruvian art, and the draw is the rooftop: a pool and a bar with the city laid out below. Rooms are bright and modern with rain showers and a Nespresso machine as standard.
goodToKnow: Every room sleeps three except the penthouse; only the entry nhow room can be set up as two twins.
Walkable to Parque Kennedy and Larcomar.
Dogs and cats up to 25 kg are welcome at a nightly charge, maximum two.
About 35 minutes from the airport by taxi.

estelar-miraflores.intro: A 151 room hotel on Avenida Benavides, in the thick of Miraflores and a short walk from Parque Kennedy. Piso 21, the restaurant and bar on the top floor, is the reason to pick it: Peruvian and international cooking with the city spread out below. There is an outdoor pool, a fitness centre, a Turkish bath and a jacuzzi.
goodToKnow: Breakfast is included on every rate the hotel sells.
The Standard Twin has two queen beds, the best value family option here.
Cafe Juan Valdez is on site for coffee.

souma.intro: The top of the Lima lineup. Souma is a five star oceanfront hotel on the Malecon in Miraflores, the first Vignette Collection property in Latin America, with a rooftop infinity pool looking straight out over the Pacific, three restaurants, a spa built around Andean and Amazonian treatments and a gym that never closes.
goodToKnow: Four categories take two double beds and sleep four, and the SOUMA Suite sleeps seven, so it is the best bet for a family or a group of friends.
The pool is open 8:00 am to 5:00 pm, a daytime feature rather than an evening one.
Accessibility is properly documented: accessible rooms, lifts, restrooms, ramps and accessible parking.
Dogs up to 15 kg stay in Premium City View rooms only, at a nightly charge.

melia-lima.intro: A five star hotel on Avenida Salaverry in San Isidro, Lima's financial district, with an outdoor pool, a wellness centre with a gym and a Turkish bath, and El Tambo for Peruvian cooking. The Level is the hotel within the hotel, upgraded rooms with their own lounge.
goodToKnow: The hotel includes airport transportation on its own rates; ask us whether it applies to your booking.
Deluxe and The Level Supreme rooms have two double beds, the family options here.
San Isidro is greener and quieter than Miraflores and closer to the airport, about 15 minutes.
Adapted rooms are sold as a category of their own.

hilton-lima.intro: A 207 room hotel on Avenida La Paz in Miraflores with an outdoor pool with whirlpools, a fitness centre, a seasonal rooftop bar and Social, the Peruvian and American restaurant on the ground floor. Parking is free, secured and covered.
goodToKnow: Breakfast is available at a charge; the hotel sells rooms with and without it.
No airport shuttle, and the drive is about 40 minutes.
Pets up to 25 kg are welcome for a fee, with a bed and feeder provided.
Under 18s are admitted only with a parent or guardian, so bring the passports and a notarised authorisation if a minor travels with anyone else.
